comments.author: @BrandCasebook-us
comments.text: The Centennial Land Run Monument and Chickasaw National Recreation Area featured around [13:52] are absolutely incredible! Seeing the 45 life-sized bronze sculptures capturing the 1889 Land Run mid-motion gives such a vivid taste of pioneer history. Transitioning right into Oklahoma’s oldest national park with its peaceful mineral springs and lush trails is a fantastic contrast. This video really showcases how much hidden natural beauty and history Oklahoma holds beyond the usual stereotypes!
